chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated from al-Sindi, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father (peace be upon him), who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said:
Whoever swallows his saliva out of respect for the sanctity of the mosque, Allah will make his saliva a cause of health in his body and he will be protected from affliction in his body.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and physical benefit of swallowing saliva in a mosque out of respect?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal* highlights the spiritual etiquette of *ta’zim* (reverence) within the mosque, linking a simple physical act to holistic well-being. It reflects the Shia emphasis on internalizing respect for sacred spaces, where such devotion is rewarded with both physical health (*sihha*) and protection from bodily afflictions (*balwa*).

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  It  is  narrated  from  Imam  Ja’far  Sadiq  (a.s.)  that  the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.s.) said, “One who swallows his spit  out  of  respect  of mosque  Allah  makes  his  mouth  the cause of safety of his body and no harm would be caused to his body.”
